A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the majority of the herbal medicines studied so far are capable of activating PXR and CAR, and that activation of these nuclear receptors by herbal medicines is a complex process involving not only the direct interaction between the herbal medicines and the receptors but also the modulation of the receptors by other factors.
